title: Iterated and joint correlated expectations
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $f,g:\{−1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$. The expectation obtained by iterating the coordinatewise coupling with correlation parameter $\rho$ on $n$ coordinates, applied to the product of $f$ and $g$, equals the expectation of $f(x)g(y)$ when $(x,y)$ is sampled from the joint law that chooses $x$ uniformly and then independently keeps or flips each coordinate to form $y$.
